title: Project 4
learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: gain experience working on a project in a team.
apply the skills and knowledge acquired in the other modules so far.
analyse and detect interesting opportunities for the implementation of advanced technologies.
design, create and present an advanced digital prototype of an interactive, immersive application and game.
evaluate their prototype e.g., by conducting user tests and recommended improvements.
Design and creation of an advanced interactive application
Practical application of various skills acquired in previous modules
Implementation of advanced technologies e.g., AR/VR, spatial audio/video, tangible interfaces
Work with digital material to create advanced prototypes
